Subject: Renewal proposal + capacity uplift options for Acme AI

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the productive QBR conversation last week. Per our discussion, attached is a pair of options to cover Acme's renewal and the expected Q3 volume uplift. High-level:

- Option A (3x year fixed commit): best unit economics, predictable billing, staged ramp across 12 months (20% / 30% / 50%). Includes dedicated priority queueing for burst windows.
- Option B (Converted to usage-first with MRR floor): flexibility to go usage-first but with a guaranteed minimum monthly recurring spend (MRR floor) so we can reserve capacity; escalator caps and one-year co-term with quarterly true-ups.

Operational asks from our side: 1) co-term date alignment to 12/31 to match your fiscal cadence, 2) a formal PO or PO number before DocuSign, and 3) a short MAP (mutual action plan) so we can sequence onboarding and capacity provisioning without interruption.

I've attached the draft MOA and a proposed MAP spreadsheet (acme-renewal-map-2026.xlsx). If you'd prefer the usage-first path, we've sketched three MRR floor tiers and the corresponding committed capacity. We can also reserve a temporary canary pool for your Q3 spike (2 weeks of burst at top-of-funnel traffic) while we bring final capacity online.

Can we do a 30-minute call on Tuesday to lock the path and timeline? If you confirm which option you prefer, I'll route to legal/finance and get a DocuSign ready.

Thanks —
Aditya Rao

Quick legal pass: please consider the following redlines to include in the revised MOA before we send to Acme for signature. I will keep the note high level, and can provide tracked changes if needed.

- Termination: 60 days' written notice for subscriptions; early termination fee limited to unbilled committed spend (no punitive multipliers).
- Auto-renew: Remove automatic renewal clause unless explicitly opted-in at enterprise tier. Add a renewal reminder schedule: 90 / 60 / 30 days.
- Data residency & security: Preserve current controls — explicit clause that customer data residency will not change except with prior notice and signed amendment. SOC2 attestation to be attached as schedule.
- Burst / capacity SLA: define burst reservation as "best-effort with X-hour notice" vs guaranteed reserved capacity. For guaranteed burst we need a paid option (we should propose a one-time reservation fee plus transition into committed capacity if used beyond 30 days).
- Billing cadence: Support split invoicing only if finance approves; Marissa to confirm. If split invoices are allowed, add early payment discount language if paying net 30 vs net 45.

Aditya — happy to draft the tracked MOA redlines today. Marissa — can you confirm whether we can do two invoices per year for this deal and whether that requires any system work (AR/Stripe)?
